summary: Astra Health is a health monitoring platform for a crew of five astronauts, built for the NASA Space Apps Challenge. Sensors connected to an ESP32 measure heart rate, temperature and humidity and stream them in real time to a web dashboard that tracks the whole crew. Charts, history and warning badges flag unsafe readings, while a risk score based on trends shows who is heading toward a critical state. A daily questionnaire follows stress, fatigue, sleep and loneliness, and the platform recommends actions such as drinking, resting or contacting the medical team. If an astronaut loses consciousness, every crew member receives an alert with rescue instructions and a video, and an assistant answers health questions on demand. details: Astra Health is an intelligent health-monitoring system designed to monitor five astronauts using an ESP32 DevKit V1 and sensors such as MAX30102, DS18B20, and DHT22. FreeRTOS manages real-time sensor acquisition, data processing, and communication tasks. Physiological and environmental measurements are transmitted securely to a Python FastAPI backend through HTTPS REST API requests in JSON format, without using MQTT. The backend stores and analyzes data using PostgreSQL, while WebSocket provides real-time dashboard updates. The platform also includes health-risk assessment, psychological questionnaires, personalized recommendations, and emergency notifications to improve crew safety and well-being.
